a.lede: It's easy to win when the defendant is a no-show.
a.title: Nintendo wins $4.5 million from lawsuit over pirated Switch games

b.lede: A Washington court granted Nintendo of America a $4.5 million default judgment after the defendant failed to appear in court and respond to the allegations. The company claimed that it sent a cease-and-desist letter and the respondent even answered via email saying they will comply and cooperate, but they have since cut-off communications.
b.title: Nintendo wins $4.5 million lawsuit against Switch pirate by default
